caption: The drawing shows a balcony scene in black and tan tones. At the top center, there are two closed window shutters depicted with horizontal lines, framed by a thin rectangular border that encloses the whole scene. In front of the shutters is a wrought iron balcony railing featuring a pattern of interlocking circles and rectangles. On either side of the balcony, there is a rectangular planter box containing leafy plants, with the leaves reaching upwards and extending above the level of the railing. The balcony floor is depicted with parallel lines indicating floorboards, and a dark shaded area beneath suggests the underside of the balcony. In the bottom right corner, the words "Casa Miró" are written in stylized script. The entire composition is bordered by a thin, single-line rectangular frame. The overall color scheme is limited to black ink over a tan or off-white background, emphasizing line, pattern, and contrast.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
